_what: Head-to-head against Reverso-Nano on GIFT-Eval MASE[0.5], split by whether the benchmark declares a seasonal period.
metric: eval_metrics/MASE[0.5]; a win is our value strictly below Reverso-Nano's
comparator: chronos-zs and census sources: the pinned GIFT-Eval snapshot's Reverso-Nano per-configuration file
grouping: configurations whose naive and seasonal-naive rows are byte-identical on every eval metric, which is how the benchmark marks no declared seasonality; see configurations.csv
